interface.title: GC×GC Chemical Insight Workbench (public release 1.2.0)
interface.field: Analytical / environmental chemistry: comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography (GC×GC), chemical property estimation, environmental fate and toxicology screening
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and interpretation, after measurement: turning measured retention times into property estimates, checking whether they can be trusted, and exporting them
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn GC×GC retention times (t1, t2) from a published or recalibrated instrument program into source-traced estimates of 51 physicochemical, environmental-fate, biological-partitioning and sensory/toxicity properties, then explore them as contour maps, peak maps and biological-system views, and check calibration quality and applicability before export.

data.note: I used the bundled 'named paper analytes' dataset (50 named compounds: n-alkanes, alkylbenzenes, PAHs, chlorobenzenes, PCBs, DDE/DDD) with the published Program A (383-min) calibration, then re-ran with Program C (99-min). No files were uploaded, so the upload routes (own analyte table, intensity chromatogram, n-alkane and calibration-chemical tables for the advanced alpha fit) were not exercised. That was a choice of this run, not a lack of inputs: the app supplies a fillable analyte template and complete Program A n-alkane (carbon_number,t1,t2) and calibration-chemical (t1,t2,A,B,S,E,V,L) example tables, which would have been enough for a test fit. This run downloaded the n-alkane example and the replay downloaded the calibration-chemical example. Files downloaded: analyte_template.csv, log_k_air_blood_results.csv, gcxgc_air_tissue_research.csv, gcxgc_51_property_estimates_wide.csv, gcxgc_51_property_estimates_long.csv, gcxgc_model_metadata.json, program_A_alkanes_format_example.csv. The replay also downloaded program_A_calibration_format_example.csv. Single-witness warning: tasks t12–t15 and t17–t22, and features f7–f11, f13, f16, f17 and f18, rest on this run alone. The replay ran out of actions before reaching them; nothing it saw contradicted them.

tree.general: Estimate many physical, environmental and biological properties for a set of measured compounds from their two-dimensional separation coordinates, judge how trustworthy the estimates are, and export them
tree.specific: Calibrate GC×GC retention times to u1/u2 coordinates, calculate the 51 property models for the paper analytes, explore them in the Property explorer and Biological systems workspace, review calibration and applicability, and download the result tables
